title: Piercing Frame Duo #040 (가슴 컷 · [일반·P25 집중형·공예(Norwegian rosemaling folk painting)·메이크업 텔레노벨라글램] ; [맥시·P100 정의형·스테인드글라스·체형 amazon bombshell])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, bust shot. TWO women standing side by side, each facing the camera straight on, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible, framed from the very top of their heads to just below their chests, the frame cutting off beneath the chests. Every face sits large and sharp in the upper half of the frame, and every woman's ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Latina woman — warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, a fiery, passionate expression, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver stud hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four thin silver bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small rubies set into the metal.
#1 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is painted in one traditional pattern: Norwegian rosemaling folk painting (a deep forest-green ground with bold cream and gold acanthus scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with acanthus scrollwork filling the space between bands, covering every inch of skin from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, the pattern reading as one continuous second skin, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

#2: A striking adult woman — THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, late 30s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in many small bantu knots covering the scalp. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a bold, commanding expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: An extreme, dense armour of about one hundred real bronze piercings with a few bronze coin drops among them covering the face: a thick bronze septum ring with a smaller ring above it and two bronze rings through each nostril; a straight bronze bar across the bridge of the nose between the brows; five thick bronze bars stacked through the outer half of each eyebrow; two rows of four small bronze studs across the forehead above the brows; four small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; a row of six small studs along each cheekbone; a bronze Medusa stud above the lips; a big bronze hoop, two smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and five small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a bronze labret stud and four rings through the chin; five small studs along each jaw; on each ear a full dense row of ten oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; and eight fine bronze chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear.
#2 Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with one material instead of ordinary skin: solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame, nowhere left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Pose: each woman faces the camera, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level. Generous spacing so every face reads clearly.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
